candidate_statistic_is: DAILY_OVERLAPPING_H_DAY: each date t, equal-weight mean of filled open(t+1)->open(t+1+20) minus one round-trip cost. Reported CAGR is (1+mean_net_h)^(242/20)-1. That is not a compounded capital path.
canonical_strategy_is: NON_OVERLAPPING_EVERY_HOLD capital account. One book, rebalance every 20 trading days, compound (1+period_return). This is the official strategy object.
